title: BECE Basic Technology & Computer Science - Computer Science - MS Word
subject: Computer Science

questions.q: In MS Word, the keyboard shortcut `Ctrl + C` is used to:
questions.explain: Ctrl+C is Copy. Ctrl+X is Cut. Ctrl+V is Paste. Ctrl+P is Print.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: To save a new document in MS Word, you can click 'File' and then:
questions.explain: 'Save As' allows you to name and save a new document. 'Save' updates an existing one.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: The 'B', 'I', and 'U' buttons on the MS Word toolbar stand for:
questions.explain: These are standard formatting tools: Bold, Italic, and Underline.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: Which feature in MS Word detects and corrects spelling errors?
questions.explain: Spell Check (often indicated by red wavy lines) identifies spelling mistakes.
questions.subject: Computer Science
